entries.question: Bpt me admission kaise le
entries.answer:
KGMU mein BPT (Bachelor of Physiotherapy) mein pravesh (admission) lene ke liye, aapko university ki adhikarik website [www.kgmu.org](http://www.kgmu.org) par jaakar "Courses & Admission" section ko check karna hoga.

KGMU mein pravesh prakriya aam taur par pravesh pariksha (Entrance Exam) ya state-level counseling ke madhyam se hoti hai. Aap niche diye gaye steps ka palan kar sakte hain:

1. **Website check karein:** [https://www.kgmu.org/courses_admission.php](https://www.kgmu.org/courses_admission.php) par jakar BPT course ke liye eligibility aur admission notification dekhein.
2. **Eligibility:** Aam taur par, aapka 10+2 (Physics, Chemistry, Biology ke sath) hona avashyak hai.
3. **Notification:** KGMU samay-samay par admission ke liye notification jari karta hai, jisme form bharne ki dates aur entrance exam ki jankari hoti hai.
4. **Counseling:** Admission ki puri jankari aur process ke liye aap university ke admission cell se bhi sampark kar sakte hain.

Kripya dhyaan dein ki admission ke niyam har saal badal sakte hain, isliye niyamit roop se [www.kgmu.org](http://www.kgmu.org) par update dekhte rahein.

entries.question: I need appointment
entries.answer:
To book an appointment at KGMU, please use one of the following methods. Please note that online registration is mandatory for all OPD patients.

**Booking Methods:**

1.  **Online Portal (ORS):** Visit [www.ors.gov.in](https://ors.gov.in). Select "Uttar Pradesh" as the state and "King George's Medical University" as the hospital. You can then select your department, date, and time slot.
2.  **Mobile App:** You can download the **ABHA** or **Health Care** app from the KGMU Play Store to book your appointment.
3.  **SMS Booking:** Send an SMS with the text "APPOINTMENT <Your Name>" to **8887019134**.
4.  **Walk-in (On-Site):** You can visit the registration counters at the hospital. You will need your **Aadhaar card** and an active mobile number to receive an OTP. 

**Important Information:**
*   **Registration Fee:** There is a flat fee of ₹50 for an OPD slip.
*   **Timings:** Monday–Friday 9:00 AM–1:00 PM; Saturday 9:00 AM–12:00 PM (Closed on Sundays).
*   **Outside-city patients:** Please ensure you carry a valid referral letter for the specific department you are visiting.
*   **Recommendation:** Pre-booking is strongly recommended to avoid long wait times.

I'm not qualified to provide medical advice. Please consult a doctor at KGMU OPD or call the helpline at **0522-2258880 / 0522-3539333**. Also, please avoid sharing personal health details, Aadhaar numbers, or other sensitive personal information in this chat for your safety.

3.  **SMS Booking:** Send an SMS in the format "APPOINTMENT <NAME>" to **8887019134**.
4.  **Walk-in:** You can visit the hospital in person. Please bring your **Aadhaar card** and an active mobile number. You will receive an OTP for registration, followed by a token and the payment of the ₹50 fee at the counter.
